'''''Puccinellia distans''''' is a species of [[Poaceae|grass]] known by the common names '''weeping alkaligrass'''<ref>{{PLANTS|id=PUDI|taxon=Puccinellia distans|accessdate=15 October 2015}}</ref> and '''European alkali grass'''. It is native to Europe and it is present in most of North America, where it is perhaps an [[introduced species]]. It grows in moist habitat, usually in areas with [[soil salinity|saline soils]], such as the edges of [[Deicing|salted roads]].<ref>[http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Puccinellia_distans&type=treatment Grass Manual Treatment] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110611101747/http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Puccinellia_distans&type=treatment |date=2011-06-11 }}</ref> It is a perennial herb producing hollow stems up to 40 to 60 centimeters in maximum height. The [[inflorescence]] is a spreading array of branches, the lower ones reflexed. The branches bear several rough-haired spikelets containing flowers.
